before.interpretation: Before receipt contains confirmed caption/group/focus/Escape failures and malformed PNG unhandled failure, plus harness issues. Disabled Undo/Redo were incorrectly included in hit-test requirements; closed retained modal geometry assertion was also corrected; Escape caused later scenario cascade. Do not count all nine failed cases as independent product defects.

after.sourceRecheck: All 16 loaded source/harness SHA256 values rechecked unchanged after final run

defects.change: Preserve UI-requested inverted caption for single/multiple ungrouped compressed media, while retaining empty-caption and file-mode guards
Synchronize local grouping and quality by their primitive fields; unrelated caption/compression changes preserve the selected grouping
Mount MediaEditor beside parent Modal, release parent focus/keyboard capture while editing, and give editor the existing focus-stack owner
Respect Windows desktop caption inset in both fixed editor and landingGhost manual-popover sizing
Handle each initial-file decode failure, revoke its created object URLs, retain valid siblings, notify through existing localization, and preserve prior selection when all files fail

scopeGaps: Live provider/server acceptance, authenticated media transfer speed and upload throughput remain unverified: all sends/cancel/download callbacks are protected mock recorders.
Document/File transfer progress uses synthetic props on actual components; there are no real uploads, downloads, messages, deletes or payments.
Malformed media rejection paths in edited-message replacement, appending files, and quality rebuild remain outside the narrowly reviewed initial-selection hook branch.
LandingGhost manual-popover geometry uses an explicit hidden synthetic viewer-host sentinel to trigger actual MediaEditor behavior; complete actual MediaViewer-to-editor lifecycle is not proved.
Viewport tests are headless Windows emulations at 1920×1080, 640×900 and 390×844; physical monitor DPI, touch hardware and GPU performance remain unverified.
Source remains NEXT working tree; canonical 1.4.4 package/runtime/proofs and installed user Relay remain untouched by this child.
performanceClaim: None: fixture UI waits and mocked actions are not a measurement of real network throughput.

reviewObjects.name: Подпись и выбор группировки/качества
reviewObjects.content: Принять проверенные NEXT изменения Composer и AttachmentModal: запрошенная подпись сохраняется без группировки, независимые настройки не сбрасывают выбор.

reviewObjects.name: Фокус, клавиатура и размеры редактора
reviewObjects.content: Принять NEXT изменения редактора: обычные pointer crop/rotate/Undo/Redo/Save/Cancel, Tab/Space/Escape, сохранение вложения и подписи, FullHD/узкие окна и scoped popover geometry проверены.

reviewObjects.name: Ошибочный PNG и сохранение выбранных файлов
reviewObjects.content: Принять отдельную atomic root правку только initial non-editing selection: invalid-alone, valid sibling, retained prior and retry проходят. Edited/appending/quality rejection остаются отдельным coverage gap.

reviewObjects.name: Исходные байты и границы проверки передачи
reviewObjects.content: Принять локальные результаты fidelity и UI controls. Нормальное фото1280×853, HQ2560×1706 и оригинал3000×2000 as-file проверены; server acceptance/реальная скорость не подтверждены и требуют отдельного разрешённого live пилота.
